response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web, cloud, and D/TypeScript background, but the role's hard requirements are almost entirely unmet: there is no evidence of Japanese language ability (native-level is mandatory), no Linux kernel source analysis or embedded firmware work, and no networking (L2/L3, switch, MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF/SNMP) or security-protocol experience. C/C++ exposure is limited to a brief 2014–2015 stint at National Instruments and a university thesis, roughly a decade out of date, and C/UNIX systems programming does not appear in the listed skills. While the candidate is clearly a capable, versatile engineer who could learn, the gap to a LAN-switch security firmware role is too large for this mid-senior IC position.
strengths: Long, varied senior-level track record across many stacks and domains
Some prior C/C++ work (NI LabWindows/CVI) and Linux/embedded-adjacent hobby projects
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, open-source leadership
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency (hard requirement)
No Linux kernel, embedded firmware, or switch/networking experience
C proficiency is dated and secondary to web/TypeScript focus

key_factors.factor: No embedded/Linux kernel or networking-security experience
